  • Method Details

    • viewport

      ScreenEmulationActionsContract viewport(int width, int height)
      Sets the current page viewport in CSS pixels through Playwright or Selenium DevTools.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when either dimension is not positive
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the live session cannot emulate a viewport

    • clearViewport

      ScreenEmulationActionsContract clearViewport()
      Clears SHAFT's viewport override. Playwright restores the viewport captured before the first SHAFT override; Selenium returns control to the underlying DevTools/browser defaults.
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the live session cannot clear its viewport override

    • screenSize

      ScreenEmulationActionsContract screenSize(int width, int height)
      Overrides the web-exposed screen width and height in CSS pixels through negotiated WebDriver BiDi.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when either dimension is not positive
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the live session has no negotiated BiDi channel

    • clearScreenSize

      ScreenEmulationActionsContract clearScreenSize()
      Clears the current-context BiDi screen-size override.
